post_primary_diagnostic.interpretation: The frozen field systematically overpredicted activation. Failure is not rescued by mediator-family partition; source/ecology and engine heterogeneity remain the dominant diagnostic structure.

track_b.effect: The product can preserve or reduce causal-language authority from machine-readable support state, but cannot create scientific authority.

scientific_conclusion: P23 prospectively removed the P22 executable-support bottleneck without consulting activation outcomes.
With 100 support-sealed fresh cells and 20 observed positive activations, the frozen P22 R1 activation field failed its pooled balanced-accuracy threshold and its cross-source robustness condition.
Therefore P22-style activation transport failure cannot be attributed to missing routed-chain support in P23.

The frozen field systematically overpredicted activation in fresh supported worlds; the largest diagnostic shifts were source/ecology and engine dependent, while MOVE_ORDER and CUTOFF had identical aggregate performance.
Q0 fiber authority does not re-enter because primary activation transport failed.
The Track-B authority router operationalizes the same support distinction as an abstention firewall without promoting product success into scientific evidence.

paper_status.reason: The P19-P23 sequence now contains prospective falsification, support-vs-model separation, fresh multi-ecology evidence, explicit negative-result value, and a non-leaking implementation consequence.
paper_status.recommended_core_result: Executable-support conditioning solved the experimental-support problem but did not rescue the frozen activation field; activation transport remained ecology- and engine-sensitive.

claim_ceiling: Do not refit R1 inside P23 or upgrade the primary FAIL from diagnostic subsets.
Do not claim Q0 fresh authority re-entry.
Do not treat executable-support conditioning as population representativeness.
Do not claim family-specific rescue from post-primary diagnostics.
Do not infer human cognition, objective chess truth, or universal activation thresholds.
Do not use Track-B CI or commentary usefulness as Track-A validation.
